metaDescription: Start free. Pay 199 zł once for one residence case, or 399 zł a year for your household. Prices in złoty, VAT included. BLIK, Przelewy24 or card.
title: Start free. Pay once per case.
lead: No subscription. Prices in złoty with VAT included. Pay with BLIK, Przelewy24 or card.
anchor: An immigration agency charges about {agency} zł for one temporary residence case (median of 15 published price lists, November 2026). Government fees are extra either way.

referBody: When someone pays with your referral code, you both get {amount} zł off.
notAdviceBody: Dossierly organises your case, explains letters and counts deadlines. It is not a lawyer and does not give legal or tax advice. For a refusal, an appeal or anything you are unsure about, it points you to free legal aid or a licensed lawyer.
a1: No. One case is a single payment that covers 18 months. The household plan is a single payment for one year; we remind you before it ends and nothing is charged automatically.
q2: What does the free plan include?
a2: Your case path, the deadline calculator, {n} letters explained and email reminders. You can stay on it as long as you like.
q3: Which payment methods can I use?
a3: BLIK, Przelewy24 and cards. Prices are in złoty and include VAT. Payments are processed by Dodo Payments, our payment provider and merchant of record, who issues your receipt.
q4: How does the referral discount work?
a4: Every paying user gets a code. When a new user pays with it, they get {amount} zł off at checkout and you get {amount} zł off your next payment.
a5: No. Most people renewing a permit can do it themselves with good organisation, and that is what Dossierly helps with. When a case needs legal judgement, use free legal aid or a lawyer.
a6: No. Your case is never sold and never used for advertising. You can delete it at any time in Settings.
finalBody: Set up in a few minutes. Start free.
seller: Sold by {seller}. Payments processed by Dodo Payments.
